text: {"contradictions":[{"a":"བྱམས་པ་དེ་ལྟ་ཡིན་ན་དེ་རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་ཙམ་དུ་མ་ཟད་དམ་","b":"བྱམས་པ་གལ་ཏེ་དེ་ལྟ་ན་རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་པ་ཙམ་དུ་མི་འགྱུར་རམ་","kind":"negation","why":"A asks if it is 'not only' (mere) conceptualization, while B asks if it 'does not become' mere conceptualization.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.why: A asks if it is 'not only' (mere) conceptualization, while B asks if it 'does not become' mere conceptualization.
